messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-01-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-29]
- On 2026-05-18, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18-2]
- INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27. [valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-12-29-2]
- As of 2025-08-14, changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- The security audit flagged long-lived tokens on the auth gateway. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service. [valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-21]
- The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-10]
- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- As of 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Farah takes the first on-call rotation for Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-16]
- Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year. [valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-13]
